panels.description: Nexus lower route. Sitara's separate TJ projects a restrained local heat map onto the ice. One intermittent human-sized signature lies beyond a collapsed passage. Leave upper-left for a location caption and upper-right for TJ dialogue.
Nayah braces a safety line while Roman clears loose ice by hand and Sitara crawls through the opening. Leave upper-left for Nayah's dialogue.
Orien lies curled beside a dead heater, frost-stiffened and near hypothermia. His battered analog watch is visible. Keep the panel silent.
Sitara places a compact satellite-capable emergency field handset with physical antenna beside Orien and activates it. Leave upper-left for Sitara's dialogue.

items.speaker: TJ
items.text: Heat source ahead. Human-sized. Motion intermittent.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: Three minutes. Then we pull you out.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: If you can call, call this.
